summary: Added the integrations app: a defended relational schema (ImportedFixture/FixtureTrack/FixtureJudge/FixtureTeam/FixtureTeamMember/FixtureProject/FixtureScore/FixtureScoreCriterion) and a destructive-then-rebuild `manage.py import_fixture` command that loads fixtures/fixtures.json (copied verbatim from the official spec) with no cleaning: the deliberate duplicate submission (prj_07/prj_41, same team/title/repo, distinct external_id and submitted_at) and the constant-scoring judge (jdg_07, 4/4/4 on all 3 reviews) both survive import unchanged. Criteria are stored as typed child rows, not a JSON blob, so a missing criterion or an unfinished review batch (called out in the fixture's own design notes as a future test-mutation case) is representable as no row rather than a sentinel value.

verification.result: passed; 5 tests (counts, duplicate preserved, constant-scorer preserved, reimport is idempotent/non-additive, criteria are typed rows)
app/worker healthy; migration 0001_initial applies cleanly against real Postgres
